description: Follow-up from a transcript: decisions and actions with owners and dates, one recap proposed to the meeting chat.

input.prompt: Follow up yesterday's SOC sync from its transcript (in the inputs) and propose the recap to the meeting chat. Also write the recap as report.md.
input.transcript:
Lea Moreau: Firewall logs are kept 90 days, the audit wants 180.
Karim Benali: Storage cost is about 2 TB more. I can draft the cost estimate by 5 November.
Me: OK, decision: we move firewall log retention to 180 days, subject to the cost estimate.
Lea Moreau: I will update the retention settings by 7 November once Karim's estimate is in.

rubric: Decision and both actions are stated with the owners and dates from the transcript

description: Transcript action with no owner and no date: marked as open, never assigned to someone invented.

input.prompt: Prepare the follow-up of the architecture board from this transcript as report.md. Do not post anything yet.
input.transcript:
Marc Dupont: The new DNS resolvers go live on 12 November, I own the cutover.
Sophie Bernard: Someone needs to update the network flow matrix before then.
Marc Dupont: Yes, we will see who.
Sophie Bernard: Decision: resolvers must log queries to the SIEM from day one.

rubric: Does not invent an owner or a date for the flow-matrix action
Marc Dupont's cutover action keeps 12 November
